messages:
sara: quick check — can someone kick off a short cross-sku micro-bench on the new l40s kernel patch? want p99 numbers for A100 / H100 / L40S, batch=1 seq=512. tagging @mike as bench owner. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/sku-comparison :eyes:

mike: ack, can do. i can run a 2hr sweep tonight and upload artifacts. @aj do we need runtime flags for the new kernel? :thumbsup:

aj: yeah, use the ksv2 kernel flag and thinbatch for these small batches. set env RKERNEL=ksv2 and REDWOOD_RUNTIME_BATCH=0.02. also add `--kv-shard=auto` on L40S. script below:

```bash
python perf_runner.py --models llama2-13b --skus a100,h100,l40s --batch-sizes 1 --seq-len 512 --kernel ksv2 --out /tmp/bench-1967
```

taylor: small note — for A100 flip IO prefetch off to avoid microburst noise: `export RW_PREFETCH=0`. otherwise tails look noisy.

bench-bot: Automated: scheduled bench job 1967654321 started by mike; eta ~2h. results will appear at https://bench.redwood.ai/jobs/1967654321

mike: started run. posting incremental updates here.

sara: thanks — if p99 delta > 10ms please ping infra oncall. i'll also watch the dashboard. :eyes:

aj: noted. i'll add a temporary alert: if p99(L40S) - p99(H100) > 15ms then fire an alert.

mike: uploading partial results (warmup ongoing): A100 p99=32ms, H100 p99=28ms, L40S p99=45ms (cold). after warmup L40S p99=36ms. full CSV: https://s3.redwood.ai/bench/1967654321/results.csv

taylor: L40S still higher on tail — could be kernel fallback for KV. @aj can you scan runtime logs for fallback traces?

aj: checking logs now — found repeated line: "kv-fallback triggered for shard 3" at ~1977600000 in runtime.log. i'll open a tiny PR to add more verbose fallback tracing and a metric.

bench-bot: Automated: job 1967654321 completed. artifacts: https://bench.redwood.ai/jobs/1967654321/artifacts.zip

sara: nice. can we rerun L40S with `--kv-shard=manual --kv-shard-count=4` to isolate shard behavior? assigning to @mike.

mike: queued the manual-shard run now, should finish by tomorrow morning. will post final numbers and a short summary. :white_check_mark:

aj: thanks — if we still see fallback traces after that, i'll schedule a quick pairing session with runtime infra.

taylor: cool, good teamwork.
